chapter: White bands and the old bands
title: John Pendleton, Joe Petit and Freddie Gould
summary: Tom cannot recall John Pendleton's instrument, notes Buddy Petit's father played key trombone with Johnny Gould, and does not know Freddie Gould.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: What did John Pendleton play? John Pendleton? John Pendleton used to play.

What did John Pendleton used to play? John Pendleton used to play. I'm getting it true. I forgot what instrument he used to play, John Pendleton. I know him good. He used to be a musician. But what instrument he used to play? I don't know. You know the way he got that.
You talked about it before. Yeah.
But you never said what he played. John Pendleton.

I don't know what instrument he used to be, John Pendleton used to play with. A cornet or trang bamboo or john Pendleton. John Pendleton. He used to have a band. But I don't remember what instrument he used to play with.
He had a string band or a brass band?
He had a string band. John Pendleton.
I live from Ballifree somewhere around there in the country.
But when he lived here, where did he live? On this side or the other side?
He lived on this side. Yeah, he lived on this side.
What bands did he play with here? Did he play with a brass band here?

Who was that? John Pellas? Well, I'll tell you the truth. Them times, I don't know what ... I know he had a string band, but I never heard him. But they had two, three bands in the city over here, uptown. And they had a couple of bands down there, the Golden Rule, all of them. Down here we had a couple of bands. Joe Petit, Buddy Petit, his father used to play key trombone. Well, he used to play with Johnny Gould in them. Yeah, he called Joe Petit. That's Buddy Petit's father. Before he was a little kid, the father would play key trombone. That's before the slides come out. You understand?
You know, I wanted to ask you, I know there's a Johnny Gould, but who was Freddie Gould? Freddie Gould. Did you know him? He's a guitar player? I don't know anything about him.
Freddie Gould. No, I forgot him. I don't know anything. I think he must be some kinder, Johnny. Yeah, yeah. Must be the young ones that just come up around. Yeah, yeah.
